title: Real stories, new icons & settings on your profile
items: Stories on THE NU now work like Instagram. Tap the + on Your story to post a photo, a video, or words on a colour. It stays up for 24 hours.
Tap someone’s circle to watch full screen. Tap the right side for the next one and the left side to go back. Hold to pause, and swipe down to close.
Reply at the bottom of a story, or tap the heart. It arrives as a text on their character’s phone, from yours.
The circle stays pink until you’ve watched everything, then turns grey. Your own story shows how many people have seen it, and you can delete it from the ⋯ button.
Profiles show a ring round the picture when that character has a story up. Tap it to watch.
New icons everywhere: thin and simple, in the style of Figma’s own app.
Emoji in the phone texts always use your own device’s style: Apple’s on iPhone, Google’s on Android, Microsoft’s on Windows.
The crown button is gone. Settings now has its own button on your profile page.

title: A cleaner look & adding several contacts
items: Phone: Add now lets you tick as many characters as you like and save them all at once. With one ticked, you can still save them under your own name for them.
One set of icons everywhere, so they all match.
No more frosted glass, pink-to-purple gradients, gradient headings or film grain. Pink stays as a solid accent.
Pages, posts and comments no longer fade or slide in, and buttons no longer float up when you point at them.
Header and home buttons are plain icons instead of a row of boxes. The selected story in the rail shows its side pill instead of a pink ring.
Small capital labels above headings are gone, and banner captions say plainly what each page is.
Writing in the app uses full stops, commas and colons instead of long dashes, and buttons no longer start with emoji.
Writer names are plain unless the writer picked their own gradient in their profile.

title: Smoother phones: pages, keyboard & interface size
items: Phones: new pages show straight away. Before, the fade-in could leave a page blank until you touched the screen.
A thin pink bar shows at the top while a page is loading, so you know your tap worked.
Typing: when the keyboard opens, the app now shrinks along with it instead of jumping into place afterwards.
Interface size: changing it on a phone now restarts the app at the new size, so every part of the screen matches and it stays that way.

title: Photo tags, Tagged tab & brand accounts
items: Tag people on photos like Instagram: in a photo post, tap Tag people, tap someone in the photo and pick who it is. No @ needed.
On the post, a small person button shows on photos with tags. Tap it (or the photo) to show the names, and tap a name to open their profile.
Tagged people hear about it, and fan comments know they are in the picture.
Profiles have a new Tagged tab: posts by other characters that tag them on a photo or @mention them.

Brand accounts: tick “This is a brand account” in a character’s editor for shops, labels, cafés, magazines… They get a BRAND badge and their own list in Directory → Brands. Fan comments on their posts talk like customers.

title: iPhone-style texts, group chats & better notifications
items: Phone conversations now look like iMessage: your texts in blue, theirs in gray, with tails, big emoji and “Read” under your last text.
Hold a text (or double-tap it) to react with ❤️ 👍 👎 😂 ‼️ ❓ or any emoji, reply, copy or delete it.
New emoji button in the text box opens an emoji picker.
Group texts: on a phone, tap Group, pick two or more people and give it a name if you like. Tap the people icon to rename it, change its photo, add people or leave.
Calls: tap the phone icon to call. The call shows in the chat and they get a missed call.
Notifications now say who texted whom, like “Mina texted Ivy” or “Ivy missed a call from Mina”, and show the character’s picture.
The phone switcher shows a red dot when another of your phones has new texts, and how many each phone has.
Messages between writers: hold a message (or use the buttons on a computer) to reply, edit, copy or delete it. Edited messages say “(edited)”.

title: Feed first, phone rail & easier comments
items: THE NU now opens on the social media feed first. Tap the Episodes button at the top to see episodes.
Phones: the rail now has Phone and Directory. Your characters live in Directory → Me, and Archive moved to the ☰ menu.
Phones: tapping the NUUVI logo opens Messages, with a row of writers at the top so you can start a chat with anyone.
Posts: the Add a comment box is now at the top of the comments. Only the first 15 comments show — tap See more for the rest. Character comments come first.
Profile gallery: the pictures now resize to fit your window or phone screen.
THE : NU is now called THE NU everywhere.

title: Menu in the rail & extra security
items: Phones: the ☰ menu button now lives at the top of the rail on the left (tap again to close the menu), so page headers have more room.
Security: the browser is told to always use HTTPS and to block other sites from reaching into NUUVI.
Too many wrong passwords for one account now pauses sign-in for that account for 15 minutes, wherever the tries come from.
Very common passwords (like password123) can't be used for new accounts or password changes.

title: Character plans on the calendar
items: New: put your characters' plans on the calendar just for fun — doctor's appointments, fittings, surgeries, work shifts, dates, classes, trips, parties…
Tap New plan on Home or the Calendar page (or tap a day on the month calendar). Pick the character, the kind, the time (or all day) and where.
Plans can repeat (every day, weekday, week, 2 weeks or month) — handy for work schedules — and can be kept to yourself with Only me.
They show on Home's week and on the Calendar in the character's color. Tap one to see it, edit it or delete it.

title: <hl> highlights & HTML in AKA lines
items: New: <hl>words</hl> puts a soft rounded highlight in your character's color around the words, without changing their color. Works in posts, texts, captions and AKA lines ([hl]…[/hl] works too).
AKA lines now understand <b>, <i>, <u>, <s> and <hl> as well as **double stars**.
Both are in the Formatting codes list, ready to copy.

title: Text box lower on phones
items: On phones the text box now sits right above the home bar instead of floating with an empty strip under it, and the side rail reaches the bottom of the screen.

title: Museum gallery & song players
items: Character galleries are now a 3D carousel: the picture in the middle is big, the ones beside it turn away. Swipe on phones; drag, scroll or use the ‹ › arrows on computers. Tap the middle picture to see it full size.
Galleries hold up to 20 pictures (was 12).
Playlist: each song can have its own link (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube or SoundCloud) and shows as a small player. Songs without a link stay as text. The big playlist player is gone.

title: Removing characters from an episode works
items: Untick a character in Episode details and save: they're now really taken out of the episode's cast. Their posts stay where they are.

title: Steadier typing on iPhone
items: While the keyboard is open, the app now stays lined up right above it instead of jumping around (or leaving a big empty gap) as you type.

title: Open a finished episode in one tap
items: A completed episode's text box now says Episode complete with an Open button right inside it. Tap Open to unlock the episode and write again (for whoever runs the episode).

title: Names in your theme, spaces kept
items: Settings → Appearance → Character names in episodes: pick Match my theme to show every name in plain black (Light) or white (Dark) instead of character colors and gradients.
Extra spaces now show exactly as you type them, in episode posts, captions and AKA lines (indents at the start of a line too).

title: Your characters live in the Directory
items: The Characters page is now Directory → Me: all your muses in a grid, with New character and Edit right there.
On phones, once you have more than ten muses the grid switches to smaller cards (three across).
By writer now shows everyone else's characters; yours are under Me (and still in All characters).
Deceased characters' label no longer has a cross.

title: Deceased & missing in action
items: Edit profile → Status: mark a character Deceased or Missing in action.
Their profile and Directory card turn grey with a label, so every writer knows they're no longer playable. They don't become NPCs.
They keep everything they've written, but can't post, comment, like, follow, text or write in episodes, and they're left out of the "Post as" lists. Switch back to Playable any time.

title: Playlists that play
items: Character profiles: paste a playlist link from Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube or SoundCloud (Edit profile details → Gallery & music) and it plays right in the About tab.
Albums, songs and artist pages work too. The typed song list is still there if you want it, shown under the player.

title: Edit comments
items: Your characters' comments on posts now have an Edit button: change the words or the date, then Save.
Anyone newly @tagged in the edit gets a notification.

title: Special characters in usernames
items: Character usernames can now use special characters and emoji, like @mina♡˚ or @ø.rose~ (up to 30). Only spaces, @, # and < > & " ' ` / \ aren't allowed.
Tagging them works too, even with punctuation right after ("@mina♡!!").
Fan comment usernames now reflect Ardell City's melting pot: names from every background instead of mostly Korean ones.

title: No more doubled fan comments
items: Editing a post again before its new fan comments arrived could bring back comments from the earlier version. Now only the newest version's comments ever show.
Fan comments written by Claude no longer repeat each other: each batch sees what's already been said, and near-copies (same words, different emojis) are dropped.

title: Fan comments that get it
items: Tag someone with @ in a caption and a row appears for them: pick what they are to your character (friend, partner, ex, rival…) and whether they're in the picture.
New "Behind the post" box: write what's really going on. Only you see it — the fan comments read it so they fit the moment.
Editing an older post: everyone tagged starts as "in the picture" if you had that switch on before.

title: Change pictures from the profile
items: On your own character's profile, tap their profile picture or banner (look for the little camera) to change it.
No banner yet? Tap the empty space at the top to add one. The banner menu also has Remove banner.

title: Location photos
items: Places can have up to 12 pictures. Open a place and tap the small pictures to flip through them.
When adding or editing a place: add several pictures at once, move them with ‹ ›, and the first one is the cover.
HARLSTON SQUARE PARK and THE ATLAS have their photos.

title: Where's that at?¿ — the Ardell City guide
items: Directory → Locations is now the guide to Ardell City: its five boroughs (East Hollow Island, Montclair Harbor, Kingsward, Cresswell and Northridge) and every notable spot, pinned on the map.
Borough names sit on the map. Pick a borough to see what it's like, zoom to it and see its spots.
Every spot has its lot type, hours, expense range and year. Pick a kind of place to narrow it down.
Add your own spots (with hours, prices and year too) and pin them on the map.

title: More of the lore
items: The Lore page has FOYAEN's MOSSETA (film & television), NOER (cosmetics) and OKINE (talent agency), and ENTITY's MONO (the "fashion bible" magazine).
INTRÉPIDE's description is updated.

title: Change a post's type when editing
items: Edit post now opens the same window as making a post, with everything filled in.
Tap Text, Photo, Video, Voice note or Stream to change what kind of post it is (a text post can become a photo post, and so on). Add the new photos or video right there.
Switch back to the original type and its photos come back.

title: A live map of Ardell City
items: Directory → Locations is now a live street map, like Apple Maps: Ardell City is NUUVI's New York, so it's New York's real streets, parks, rivers and buildings, with the real borough and neighbourhood names hidden.
Zoom, drag, rotate, and tap 3D to tilt over the buildings. It turns dark at night with dark mode.
Character dots and place pins work like before: tap a pin to see who's there. Tap the map to pin a new place exactly where it is.
If the map can't load (say, a bad connection), the drawn map shows instead.

title: The Ardell City map, ending episodes and progress bars
items: Directory → Locations now has a map of Ardell City. Places are pinned on it, and little glowing dots show which characters are where right now, from the open episodes set there.
Tap a pin to see the place and who's there. Zoom with + and −, a pinch, or Ctrl + scroll; drag to look around.
When you add a location, tap the map to pin it. Admins can swap the drawn map for their own map picture.
The Directory opens on the characters again (Locations is its own tab inside it).
End episode: a button at the top of an episode locks it and marks it complete.
On THE : NU, episode banners have a progress bar like Netflix. It creeps forward with every post and fills up when the episode ends.

title: Locations, pinned posts and lots of fixes
items: Locations: a new section (sidebar → Locations, or Directory → Locations) of places in Ardell City, with a picture, the borough and the kind of venue. Anyone can add one.
Pin up to 3 posts to the top of a character's profile (post menu → Pin to profile). Profiles now show posts by their date, so back-dated posts sit in the right place.
Characters can have a Thread picture, shown on their thread posts instead of their social media avatar.
Self paras now read like regular threads.
Change the order of photos while making a post: drag them, or use ‹ ›.
Order the episodes in a story's sidebar by story order, latest post, newest, oldest or name (the slider button next to Episodes).
Liked by shows two names; tap it to see every character who liked the post.
Comments can be dated (the calendar button next to Post) to match older posts.
Notifications now say who did what: "Mina tagged Yoonoh in a post" and "Mina commented on Yoonoh's post: …".
Your own characters can follow each other.
Fixed: photo posts on computers getting stuck after 2–3 photos, and new messages not showing on phones until you tapped Messages again.

title: Writing tools by Claude
items: Check my writing: fixes spelling and grammar but keeps your voice and formatting. In stories it's in the + panel; on THE : NU it's under the caption. You see the fixes before anything changes.
Catch up: a "Previously on…" recap at the top of episodes, to get back into the story before you post.
See translation now uses Claude, so slang and emojis come through.
Automatic NPCs and the gossip account write fresh lines in their own voice, reacting to what's happening.
These only appear when the site has an Anthropic API key.

title: Fan comments that look at your pictures
items: When the site has an Anthropic API key, fan comments are written by Claude, who looks at the actual photos as well as the caption, place, song and tags.
Comments arrive a few seconds after you post or edit; the post page shows them as soon as they're ready.
Without a key, NUUVI keeps using its built-in comment writer.

title: Feed refresh and smarter tags
items: On phones, THE : NU has a refresh button at the top to pull in the newest posts.
Saving an edit to a post deletes its old fan comments and writes a fresh set that fits.
New switch on posts: "The people I @mention are in the picture". Fan comments only say someone is in the photo when it's on.

title: Musings, group connections, birthdays and Ardell City weather
items: Fan comments never repeat on a post, react to the caption, @mentions, hashtags and the photos themselves (colour, light, how many), and bring up the place or song only now and then.
Set a comment number and at least a quarter of it is written out as fan comments. Characters' own comments always sit at the top.
Editing a post's caption, place or song gives it fresh comments that fit.
Type @ in a caption or comment to pick a character; mentions and #hashtags show in NUUVI pink, and hashtags open their own page.
Posts can be back-dated, and their like and comment numbers are set right in the post and edit screens.
Posts show "Liked by @someone and 2,301 others".
Musings: a new kind of post with its own filter on THE : NU.
Connections can be edited and can need more than one person (group connections).
Story circles stay perfectly round.
Home: a taller calendar on phones with the Ardell City weather forecast, and characters' birthdays.
Birthdays: NUUVI Official posts a pinned happy birthday on THE : NU for the whole day; birthdays also show in the calendar.
Character profiles now live in the About tab on each character's page. NPCs are a category in the Directory.
Phones: Messages moved to the left bar; the Edit profile button on your own profile is gone (the crown does it).
Header pictures change every 4 minutes.

title: Profiles, episode covers and a cleaner phone
items: Profiles: a new place (the card icon in the left bar, or the menu) with a detailed profile for every character, NPCs included: quick facts, personality, history, relationships, loves and hates, a gallery and a playlist.
Episodes can have their own picture, a season number and a location. THE : NU shows the episode's picture instead of the story's.
Tag a location on THE : NU posts, and in episodes: the Location button in the + panel marks where the scene moves to.
Fan comments sound like real people: they react to what you posted, use your character's pronouns (set them in their profile), and not all of them are nice.
Videos on THE : NU play by themselves, muted, shaped to the video; tap the speaker for sound.
On phones the app stays between the clock and the home bar, with a soft fade at each edge. The left bar has more breathing room.
The phone's back arrow and the top back button no longer fight each other.
Messages: more space above names (they're no longer tappable by accident) and a Jump to latest button when you scroll up. Also in episodes and phone texts.
Pictures upload sharper, editors show the best sizes, and very small pictures get a heads-up.
HTML works in posts and profiles (<center>, <b>, <span style="color: …">…), and the formatting guide has Copy and Insert buttons plus ready-made layouts.
Change your username in Settings (once every 3 hours), and choose whether About shows on your profile.
The logo in the left bar is smaller, with the online count in its own pill underneath.

title: THE : NU, connections and messages
items: The feed is now THE : NU, laid out like Instagram: one column of posts in the order they were made, with story bubbles at the top.
Posts with several photos show 1/3 and dots; swipe, or use the arrows on a computer. Double-tap a photo to like it.
Connections: put out an idea for one of your muses (posted by you, the writer). Anyone can pick it up for one of their characters, then it locks.
Episodes on THE : NU show the writer who started them.
Likes start from a character's followers, and every real like adds one. Fans comment on their own, and more of them when you raise the comment number.
Reply to comments, see comment likes, and tap See translation on comments that aren't in English. Characters' names show in their colors.
Messages: private conversations between writers replace OOC channels. Comms are now the Phone, linked from every story.
Phone: change a contact's picture on your phone only, long-press contacts on phones, and a new message bar.
A back button on phones, the crown for settings, Save at the top of Settings, no grey outlines on profile pictures, and more motion everywhere.
On phones (and the home-screen app) NUUVI now stays below the clock and battery and fills the screen to the bottom, like Discord.
Admins can edit any story's settings, header picture and icon. Long-press on phones (or right-click on computers) a story icon, the story name or an episode in the sidebar for quick options.
Pictures people send open in NUUVI's own viewer instead of a new tab: swipe or use the arrows for more, tap outside or ✕ to close.

Fixed: saving a character without choosing bot or NPC now just keeps them in your cast. Character pictures beside episode posts are always cropped to fit. Typing in messages and chats on a phone no longer makes the screen jump.
On phones, the reply and ••• buttons on messages now sit up by the name instead of on top of the words.
Character pictures beside episode posts show on iPhones again.
Drag stories in the sidebar into your own order. On phones, hold a story and slide your finger. Your order is saved to your account.
Add writers to a story by username (Story settings → Writers).
Delete any channel, even the last one. Long-press or right-click a channel in the sidebar for Delete.
The + in chats opens a Discord-style picture panel: camera, your recent pictures, Photos, Link / GIF and more.
Admins can open every writer's stories again, private ones too. Only a private story owned by an admin is hidden from other admins until they're added.
Messages live in the main menu only, not inside stories.
The Phone inside a story opens within the story, keeping its sidebar.
New Archive under Home: mark a finished story complete and it moves there, read-only, until you reopen it. Old OOC/comms channels inside a story are now under Old chats.
The picture panel has big Camera and Photos buttons that open your phone's own camera and photo library, and it fits the screen.

title: Your colors, the lore, and fitted headers
items: Pick your own gradient under You & settings → Your colors. It colors your display name and the writing-style bars on your profile.
New characters start with the pink-to-purple gradient on their writing.
The lore is now its own page for the whole NUUVI world, not part of any story: tap Lore in the sidebar, or the lore card on Home.
Header pictures now fill their banner neatly, cropped around faces.
Set the like and comment numbers on your characters' posts (••• → Set like & comment numbers).
NPC categories show their name in capitals with the gradient when you open one.
Themes are now just Auto, Light and Dark.
This pop-up! You'll see what changed after each update.

title: Comms sides, phone layout and formatting
items: Comms between two of your own characters: the one who started it is the sender, on the right.
On computers, your phone's contacts and texts fill the page side by side.
Lots more formatting from Discord and Jcink (see + → Formatting guide). GIFs keep moving.
The Overview can open with a gossip column.
